packageRules.description: React/Next: framework surface, kept in one reviewed group.
TypeScript/ESLint: kept in one reviewed group.
Playwright/browser tooling: kept in one reviewed group so the pinned Chromium build and the MCP server move together.
Accessibility tooling: kept in one reviewed group.
Issue #252: majors on providers/engines with real behavior or cost risk stay manual - never automerged, never grouped away from a dedicated review.
Issue #252: automerge only dev-only patch updates, and only after every required CI check passes.
Everything else (runtime deps, and every minor/major not covered above) stays a reviewed PR by default.

customManagers.description: Issue #252: .codex/config.toml pins the Playwright MCP server's own npm version instead of floating on @latest (docs/agents/coding-conventions.md, 'Dependency maintenance'). Renovate reads/writes that pin the same way it would a package.json dependency.
